_readme: RESEARCH PROJECT TEMPLATE. This file is ignored by the build (filenames starting with _ are skipped). To add a project: copy this file to content/projects/my-project.json, remove the leading underscore from the filename, fill in the fields, and delete anything you do not need.
title: [Project title]
status: [Status — e.g. Undergraduate Thesis, ICSSR Research Project, Manuscript preparation]
short: [One sentence describing the project, used on the homepage and research list.]
description: [Overview: a short academic summary of the project, two or three sentences.]
researchQuestion: [The central research question, stated in one or two sentences.]
background: [The theoretical motivation for the project, in a short paragraph.]
currentStatus: [Current status — e.g. Conceptualization, Data collection, Analysis, Manuscript preparation, Completed]
